title: Customer waiting too long
trigger_condition: longest in-flight queue wait > alert_wait_ms (fallback: verified congestion_threshold_seconds 120 s), held 10 s
recommended_action: Send a floater to open a second till or assist at the queue head; check self-checkout staffing.
data_dependencies: queue inflight waits + episodes (needs queue analytics upgrade, in flight)

title: Queue length over comfort
trigger_condition: queue_length > alert_length (fallback: verified max_comfortable_queue 4) held 10 s
recommended_action: Brief a colleague to the till; consider opening lane 2.

title: Active queue with nobody serving
trigger_condition: linked staff zone has 0 tagged staff >= 30 s (no_staff_grace_seconds) while QUEUE_WAIT_OVER or QUEUE_LENGTH_OVER is active
recommended_action: Dispatch nearest colleague to checkouts immediately.
data_dependencies: linked staff zone tagging (verified) + queue alert state (in flight)

title: Abandon rate high (lane losing customers)
trigger_condition: abandon_rate > abandon_threshold (operator-set, suggested default 15%) AND completed >= 10 settled outcomes AND service evidence exists (service_point or head_exit)
recommended_action: Walk the lane: pricing at head, basket limits, till speed; rebalance staffing at peak hours.
data_dependencies: queue episodes + graded service evidence (needs queue upgrade)

title: Store near occupancy limit
trigger_condition: store people_now >= 0.9 x store_capacity_people for 2 min
recommended_action: Stagger door entry; slow the queue merge; prep the over-limit procedure.
data_dependencies: store occupancy from active tracks (verified) + NEW calibration store_capacity_people

title: Store over occupancy limit
recommended_action: Hold entry at the door; open an immediate relief exit; log the event time for the duty record.
data_dependencies: store occupancy from active tracks (verified) + NEW calibration store_capacity_people

title: Entrance counted nobody for a long window
trigger_condition: business hours AND decode fps > 0 AND stream fresh AND entrance trip_in count == 0 for 30 min
recommended_action: Walk the door: locked? bypassed? Camera view shifted? Check the tripwire after your last calibration edit.
data_dependencies: tripwire events + fps trio + snapshot freshness (all verified)

title: Camera feed down
recommended_action: Check camera power/RTSP link; dashboards will show NO DATA honestly, not zeros.

title: Edge throughput degraded
trigger_condition: infer/display fps < throughput_floor (operator floor, suggested 2.0) >= 5 min while decode_fps stays normal
recommended_action: Reduce EDGE_MAX_CAMERAS or imgsz, or switch perf modes; expect counts to lag what eyes see.

title: Zone crowding above cap
recommended_action: Open an adjacent lane or deflect foot traffic; restaff the zone.
data_dependencies: zone occupancy (verified) + NEW per-zone calibration zone_capacity_people

title: Busy zone with zero staff visible
trigger_condition: zone occupancy >= busy_floor for 10 min AND staff_now == 0 during business hours
recommended_action: Move or schedule cover into the high-browse area.
data_dependencies: zone occupancy + staff presence tagging (both verified)

title: Display interest unusually high
trigger_condition: category detections per window >= 3x same-hour rolling mean built from real product-window history
recommended_action: Face-up and restock the display; watch for stockout in the following hours.

title: Traction heatmap stale
recommended_action: Check disk space and heatmaps config; a truly idle camera can also lag writes (acceptable).
clear_condition: heatmap file newer than 2 x write interval

title: Promo conversion vs footfall
trigger_condition: promo redemptions / entries deviates beyond the operator band (requires POS tie-in)
recommended_action: Owned by the POS integration owner once receipts are linked (separate consented intake).

title: Abandoned-basket revenue lost
trigger_condition: graded queue-abandon events x POS price of the basket proxy
recommended_action: Retune staffing at abandonment-prone hours; the revenue numerator needs POS data.
data_dependencies: queue abandon flag (graded, in flight) + POS price lookup (future)

title: Age-restricted checkout unattended
trigger_condition: person below the age threshold at a restricted till with no staff beside them
recommended_action: Compliance process: page a supervisor per the store SOP.
data_dependencies: verified-age signal (NOT derivable from anonymized video; assumed-governed external source)

title: Returning visitor follow-up
data_dependencies: cross-day identity (forbidden by design in this system)

title: Aisle chiller temperature excursion
trigger_condition: IoT sensor temperature outside the food-safety band for 5 min
recommended_action: Check the chiller unit; complete the food-safety log per SOP.
data_dependencies: IoT temperature sensors (NOT in edge data; video never substitutes for a thermometer)
clear_condition: sensor back in band for 10 min
